matt: Evening handoff — I'm primary until 23:00 PT. Secondary is @lina. Heads up: there's a scheduled autoscaling maintenance window that creates a short coverage gap from ~19:40-20:00 PT (warm pool reboots). If anything customer-impacting happens during that gap follow the escalation matrix below. I'll leave the runbook pointers and key playbooks pinned.
lina: ack. adding to my calendar. can you paste the exact paging steps you want us to follow during the gap? want to be explicit for the rotation cover.
ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance: autoscaler-restart at 2025-09-12T19:40:00-07:00 (window 20m). Maintenance ID: maint-20250912-07
anya: TL;DR for the gap -> page both primary + secondary immediately if customer-impacting (S1 or >1% user impact). If it's degraded but not customer-impacting, follow the normal page -> 5m -> escalate flow. Also open the bridge early so we have context.
cecil: proposal for explicit paging matrix:
```text
- Severity 1 (customer-facing outage): page PD -> wait 1 min -> if no ack, call mobile -> page #eng-oncall Slack with `@channel` -> escalate to SRE lead and infra manager.
- Severity 2 (degradation impacting >1 customer segment): page PD to primary -> wait 5m -> escalate to secondary -> open bridge.
- Severity 3 (internal / minor): Slack thread in #eng-oncall, assign owner, no page unless hit SLO thresholds.
```
matt: +1 to cecil's matrix. small tweak for the maintenance gap: treat any S2 as S1 for paging (i.e., immediate dual-page + bridge) between 19:40-20:00. Also add DB failover note — use the db-failover runbook if you see >20% replica lag:
- Runbooks: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/db-failover and /runbooks/incident-escalation
lina: ok. for phones: if PagerDuty doesn't get an acknowledgement in the window, ring mobile after 2 attempts. PD policy = page primary -> escalate to secondary after 5m -> if still unacked after additional 10m escalate to `sre-lead` and trigger exec notify (per on-call policy). I'll add numbers to the handoff doc.
sre-lead: I'll standby for 20:00-21:30 PT in case anything needs lead-level decisions. If the incident meets "customer-visible degraded service" or we hit >5% error-rate, escalate me immediately. If a database promotion is required, page me and include the DB playbook link.
matt: putting the final matrix in the handoff doc now. copying exact copy here so it's available in channel quickly:
```text
Paging matrix (finalized):
- During normal hours:
  * S1: PD -> wait 1m -> escalate to phone -> slack `@channel` -> SRE lead
  * S2: PD -> wait 5m -> escalate to secondary -> open bridge
  * S3: Slack + owner
- During maintenance gap (19:40-20:00 PT):
  * Any S2+ => treat as S1: PD -> page primary + secondary concurrently -> open bridge immediately -> call mobiles if PD unacked after 1m
``` 
lina: thanks. can you also add the quick-check list for whoever is taking over the shift? e.g., alerts to silence, outstanding pagers, active bridges, any patches in progress.
matt: done — added a "handoff quick-check" checklist to the doc and pinned it. checklist excerpt:
```text
- confirm primary/secondary & mobile numbers
- confirm active bridges (links)
- list running maintenance windows
- outstanding pagers and incident IDs
- SLO status (errors/drop in p50/p95)
```
cecil: tiny nit: can we add a one-line guidance under the doc header: "If in doubt, escalate early — we can always scale down notifications later." Prevents people from waiting.
matt: adding that now. will push to pinned doc in ~2m. anyone object to this change? otherwise i'll consider the handoff updated and DM the rotation with the changes.
anya: no objections. thank you.
ops-bot: Document updated: /docs/handoffs/evening-handoff-2256789012 (pinned in #eng-oncall)
matt: thanks all. quick reminder: if you inherit the shift and see an unacked PD for >3m, escalate to `sre-lead` and call the oncall mobile. I'll also drop a one-line summary into the calendar invite for the rotation so it's visible to whoever picks it up.
lina: ACK — i'll run the handoff checklist when I take over at 19:00 PT and report back in this thread if anything looks off.
sre-lead: appreciate the clarity. i'll be reachable and will jump on the bridge if we escalate. :thumbsup:
matt: closing out this handoff thread. everyone please DM if you need the mobile numbers or want edit rights on the doc. :white_check_mark:"
